summary: The Knowledge website redesign is at a decisive working-session stage while SEO and conversion tracking for Asia Star and Intelligent China ramp up, and a cluster of event and content deliverables needs attention this week.
summaryDetail: The most pressing thread is the Knowledge website redesign: two homepage concepts were reviewed and the team settled on keeping the two-menu structure, adopting an editorial layout with a pinned lead article, folding in BCI/BSI indices, and dispersing videos by topic instead of a standalone section. Joseph, Julie and the design lead now owe a 30-minute working session to mark specific feedback, with Joseph sharing the inspiration HTML and Joker applying changes. In parallel, the SEO push prioritises Asia Star and Intelligent China (with Berkeley as a possible third for the audit phase), and the team still needs to deliver the search-focus brief, participant/CRM lead analysis, and a conversion-tracking audit. This week also carries concrete event and content actions: the SwissCham forum cooperation email, updated APEC report versions to CZC, MBA new-intake social posts, spotlight-video promotion for Andrea and Katya, and sharing the new English case studies. Upcoming decisions include settling the Chinese name for the Women in Leadership event (avoiding 论坛 per the new review constraints) and confirming CKGSB's role as free Knowledge Partner at the 2026 Sino-Swiss Economic Forum, while the ESG report stays on the back burner.

decisions.text: Stale saved passwords across devices caused the account lockout; all devices must be re-authenticated.
Remove the standalone video section and disperse videos by topic across the site
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge menu and School menu), with School menu top right in gray
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the Knowledge section, similar to the school homepage banner
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the very top of the homepage
Adopt editorial-style layout to display more articles, with a pinned article top-left and latest articles alongside/below
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for promotion.
